reading.text: We look around a room. A book is in the table, and a bag is on the chair. Another object is under the desk. We move the objects and practice the place words together. We also remember earlier words such as snore and doze.
reading.imageBrief: One uncluttered prepositions of place scene supporting the reading and showing the first six target words.
